title: How Great Thou Art
lyrics_original: O Lord My God when I in awesome wonder
Consider all the works Thy hands have made
I see the stars I hear the rolling thunder
Thy power throughout the universe displayed
Then Sings My Soul
my Savior God To thee
How Great Thou Art
How Great Thou Art
When through the woods And forest glades I wander
And hear the birds sing sweetly in the trees
When I look down From lofty mountain grandeur
And hear the brook and feel the gentle Breeze   ||Then Sings||
And when I think That God His Son not sparing
Sent Him to die I scarce can take it in
That on the cross my burden gladly bearing
He bled and died to take away my sin     ||Then Sings||
When Christ shall come With shouts of Acclamation
And take me home what Joy shall fill my heart
Then I shall bow in humble adoration
And there proclaim my God how great thou art      ||Then Sings||

bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవా మహాత్మ్యముగలవాడు ఆయన అధికస్తోత్రము నొందదగినవాడు ఆయన మహాత్మ్యము గ్రహింప శక్యము కానిది
bible_verses.english: Great is the Lord and most worthy of praise; his greatness no one can fathom.

bible_verses.telugu: నీ చేతిపనియైన నీ ఆకాశములనునీవు కలుగజేసిన చంద్రనక్షత్రములను నేను చూడగా నీవు మనుష్యుని జ్ఞాపకము చేసికొనుటకు వాడేపాటి వాడు?నీవు నరపుత్రుని దర్శించుటకు వాడేపాటివాడు?
bible_verses.english: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have set in place, what is mankind that you are mindful of them, human beings that you care for them?

bible_verses.telugu: నా ప్రాణమా, యెహోవాను సన్నుతించుము. యెహోవా, నా దేవా నీవు అధిక ఘనతవహించిన వాడవు నీవు మహాత్మ్యమును ప్రభావమును ధరించియున్నావు.
bible_verses.english: Praise the Lord, my soul. Lord my God, you are very great; you are clothed with splendor and majesty.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord my God, when I look at the beauty of Your creation, my heart fills with humble wonder. Thank You for displaying Your power and tenderness in the world all around me. Help me to slow down today so I can hear Your voice and see Your hand at work. I offer You my worship and gratitude, singing with all my heart how great You truly are. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: How Great Thou Art invites us to step outside the noise of daily life and simply look up at the majesty of God’s creation. From the vast night sky to the gentle songbirds in the forest, every detail of the natural world speaks of a loving Creator whose power knows no bounds. When we pause to notice His handiwork, our hearts naturally shift from worry to wonder. It moves us to lift our voices in spontaneous praise, declaring the greatness of our Savior God.
